title: Engine lookup falls back to an old ~/.openagents/bin/microcoder when the running binary was rebuilt (Linux "(deleted)" path)
body: On Linux, a running OpenAgents program can be replaced by a rebuild while it continues running. Engine discovery then falls back to an older `~/.openagents/bin/microcoder` even though a fresh `microcoder` is beside the program. Linux can report the running executable with a trailing ` (deleted)` marker. Fix `default_controller` in `crates/coder/src/task/autostart.rs` so the sibling engine remains preferred after replacement, while preserving ordinary sibling selection and installed-engine fallback when no sibling exists. Report a missing engine when neither location is available. Add a regression test without touching installed programs.
